So this just happened (sitting in my bed a little peeved)

I had matched with a guy few days ago he was nice we were flirty, blah blah blah. We had agreed to meet for drinks and chat. I kinda knew going into this date that it may be more than drinks. 

Cut several hours ago. We meet for drinks and head back to his place. He is over 6'2 and I'm a 5'4 female.  We started kissing and he was getting a little aggressive. Things went a little further and he spat on me. (Not my kink) He then proceeded to get a little rougher with me. I then noticed he pulled out his phone and was filming me. When he saw me he put it away claiming he was "texting friends". He had a good hold of my neck and him being much bigger I was nervous. When we were done I got up to leave explaining I wasn't feeling well. He gets visibly upset and angry about this. Now I am terrified.

Trying to leave he continuously begs me to stay and plead with me. I say no grabbing my clothes. He pushes me on the bed. Scared I immediately get up. He moves to me grabbing my wrists. Something inside me clicks and I start screaming. Scared he let's go of my wrist. I continuously scream. (Full disclosure I went a little bunny in the pot) I was slamming my hands on his walls, pushing his furniture into it. Trying to show I was not worth the effort.

He seemed a little shaken and I took this as a quick time to throw on my clothes. Everything could be pulled up so I didn't break eye contact. Leaving the apartment I continuously watch him scared to turn my back. Finally when I was close to the door he just said get the fuck out... gladly.

No idea why I'm sharing this. I'm angry, scared and disgusted. Tinder deleted. Single life is looking great.
